title: Walls of a Kind
subtitle: Nothing declares this quest's prerequisite
description: No dependsOn field on this file. It unlocks when the quest above it in
the chapter's list is done, because the chapter is linear.
Spelling that out as a dependency would have worked and would have been
the same thing said twice. `size: 40` makes this stop a little smaller
than the first one, which is a drawing decision and nothing else.
